parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: DestinationType
parameters.description:
The type of the destination service. Valid values:

*   Single
*   Multiple
*   VersionOriented
*   Mock
*   Redirect

parameters.name: EnableWaf
parameters.description: Specifies whether to activate Web Application Firewall (WAF).

parameters.name: Fallback
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the Fallback service.

parameters.name: FallbackServices
parameters.description: The information about the Fallback service.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Policies
parameters.description: The routing policy in a JSON string.

parameters.name: RouteOrder
parameters.description: The sequence number of the route. (A small value indicates a high priority.)

parameters.name: RouteType
parameters.description:
The route type. Valid values:
